name: Self Employment Scheme Gujarat
benefit: - **Monetary Benefit:** Loan assistance between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000, depending on the chosen business activity.- **Interest Rate:** 4% per annum.- **Coverage:** Applicable for 85 different types of businesses as identified by the department.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. - The applicant must be unemployed at the time of applying.
